description: This file contains schema validation functions for localization JSON files, including functions to flatten nested objects, check for missing or extraneous keys, validate non-empty values, and perform schema validation across multiple languages. It also imports schema data and external modules for file system operations and path handling.

methods.name: flattenAnObject
methods.description: Recursively flattens a nested object into a single-level object with dot-separated keys.

methods.name: findMissingKeys
methods.description: Checks for keys present in the schema but missing in the translation file.

methods.name: findExtraneousKeys
methods.description: Checks for keys present in the translation file but not in the schema.

methods.name: noEmptyObjectValues
methods.description: Validates that all values in an object (including nested objects) are non-empty.

methods.name: schemaValidation
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation of a JSON translation file against its schema, including key presence, extraneous keys, empty values, and specific quote object validation.

methods.name: readJsonFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file from the locales directory for a given language and filename.

methods.name: translationSchemaValidation
methods.description: Validates translation JSON files for all client languages except English.

methods.name: motivationSchemaValidation
methods.description: Validates motivation JSON files for all client languages except English.

methods.name: introSchemaValidation
methods.description: Validates intro JSON files for all client languages except English.

methods.name: metaTagsSchemaValidation
methods.description: Validates meta-tags JSON files for all client languages except English.

methods.name: linksSchemaValidation
methods.description: Validates links JSON files for all client languages except English.
